page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.g5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This server type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units (GPUs), limiting its applicability for hardware-accelerated workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density position this instance for enterprise workloads requiring predictable compute and memory resources. It is designed for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded processing tasks, web serving, and medium-sized database deployments that rely on network-attached storage.
